definitions.explanation: The color silver, or anything that shines with a silvery white color.

definitions.gloss: snow-covered landscape; silvery world of snow
definitions.explanation: A poetic and literary term for a landscape covered in white snow, evoking the image of a silver world.

examples.japanese: {白銀|はくぎん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧。
{白銀|はくぎん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{老人|ろうじん}→老人：03784_roujin⟧。
examples.english: An elderly person with silver hair.

notes:
A literary and poetic word that evokes beauty and brilliance. Often used in descriptive writing, poetry, and winter-themed content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白銀|はくぎん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧: silver/snowy world
- {白銀|はくぎん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{輝|かがや}く→輝く：02032_kagayaku⟧: to shine silvery white
- {白銀|はくぎん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{覆|おお}われる→覆う：02020_oou⟧: to be covered in silver/snow
- {白銀|はくぎん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧: silvery light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{銀色|ぎんいろ}→銀色：05068_giniro⟧: silver color — everyday, neutral
- シルバー: silver — loanword, used for objects and colors
- ⟦{銀|ぎん}→銀：02651_gin⟧: silver (the metal)
- {銀白色|ぎんはくしょく}: silver-white — technical/scientific

REGISTER:
More literary and evocative than ⟦{銀色|ぎんいろ}→銀色：05068_giniro⟧. Commonly used in travel writing, literature, and poetic descriptions of winter landscapes.
